basic_details.job_title: SHSRC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Health System Fellow, Nursing Consultant Posts
basic_details.short_information: State Health Systems Resource Centre, Meghalaya (SHSRC) has notified 8 contractual vacancies, comprising 2 Health System Fellow posts and 6 Nursing Consultant posts. Qualifications for these posts vary by position, requiring either graduate or postgraduate studies in relevant disciplines or a Master's degree in nursing with valid registration. The engagement is contractual with specific tenures, offering a pay of Rs. 50,000 for the Health System Fellow and Rs. 70,000 for the Nursing Consultant. Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Meghalaya / RHFWTC
12 months for Health System Fellow / One year for Nursing Consultant (extendable)
Health System Fellow and Nursing Consultant
North Garo Hills (Fellows) / Shillong with extensive travel across Meghalaya (Nursing Consultants)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable experience for Health System Fellows includes programme management, working with government health systems or district administrations, stakeholder coordination, social research, and documentation. Desirable skills include strong programme coordination, proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, and the ability to speak Garo. Desirable experience for Nursing Consultants includes clinical teaching, mentorship, supervision, competency-based education, quality improvement, and emergency care. Desirable skills include clinical mentorship, documentation, and the ability to speak and write in local languages (Khasi, Garo, or Pnar). FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? rows.essential_qualification: Graduate or postgraduate qualification in public health, social work, management, psychology, or other relevant social science discipline from a recognised institution.
Master's degree in nursing (MSc Nursing) in the relevant specialisations with a valid registration with the relevant Nursing Council.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Health System Fellows receive a monthly remuneration of INR 50,000 for a full-time contractual position of 12 months. Nursing Consultants receive a monthly remuneration of INR 70,000 for a full-time one-year contractual position, which is extendable on a performance basis with an initial probation period of three months.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SHSRC Health System Fellow
content_sections.text: Access the application portal via the provided online application link. Fill in all required details in the application form. Submit the form before the last date of 26 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the second round of recruitment and personal interviews.

faq.question: Q1. Are these posts permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: Both positions are full-time contractual engagements for a period of 12 months, with Nursing Consultant positions extendable on a performance basis.

faq.question: Q2. How are candidates shortlisted for selection?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the second round of recruitment and personal interviews.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for both roles is 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications required for the Nursing Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's degree in nursing (MSc Nursing) in the relevant specialisation along with a valid registration with the relevant Nursing Council.
